subject: geom_line does not plot anything when x is a factor:

messages.author: a71c537b47331ea2
messages.subject: geom_line does not plot anything when x is a factor:
parts:
Dear Hadley,

This does not work for me:


df <- data.frame(x=factor(c(1:4)), y=1:4)
ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) + geom_line()

i.e. nothing is ploted :( Same for geom_path()

geom_point() works fine instead.

This does not look as desired feature, is it?
If so how can one plot x= aesthetic, a numeric variable, in a different
order than strictly increasing?

Thanks,
Vitalie.

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: geom_line does not plot anything when x is a factor:
parts:
Hi Vitalie,
I don't know if that's a desired feature, I think Hadley can answer that. But I think it doesn't work because ggplot interprets it as being different groups. To make it work, add group=1 in the aes:

ggplot(df, aes(x, y, group = 1 )) + geom_line()

Bye
Luciano


2009/9/8 Vitalie S. <vito...@rambler.ru>

messages.subject: Re: geom_line does not plot anything when x is a factor:
parts:
Thanks Luciano,

Indeed that works. I completely forgot that groups are taken as
intersection of all factor aesthetics. That is exactly the reason my
example works with numeric variable but not with discrete.

Cheers,
Vitalie.
